correctness.rationale: Every terminal formula is piecewise one of 0,1,x,1-x on five comparison strata; induction fixes all extrema with three singleton and four endpoint representatives. Both modal operations at the root are preserved for all nested formulas. Seven specific degrees have seven independent exposing formulas, and explicit crisp tests give all six strict stages. The standard-library checker replayed 101 indicator cases, 1,715 multiset validity cases, 22,500 nested comparisons, and seven indispensable-leaf witnesses. This is a symbolic universal proof with finite corroboration; empty-successor boundary, m=1 and all quantifiers are addressed.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact, optimal, formula-independent witness bound across the complete one-variable language plus an explicit complete hierarchy of star-validity expressivity. The five-stratum classification explains structurally why involution adds four necessary witnesses to non-involutive three-leaf behavior; the sharp seven-stage cutoff answers a natural bounded-branching semantics question with direct finite-template utility.
